title: Be able to + or - delay activity time
symptom: The user wants to be able to input a delay (past or future) when entering an activity, similar to how carbs can be entered with a delay. They note that entering activity via the carbs menu allows a delay and changes the target, but entering via the activity button does not.
fix: The user found that entering activity via the carbs menu (even without entering carbs) allows a delay and changes the target, so the request is no longer justified. They close the issue.
evidence_quote: If you enter activity via _carbs_ menu (even without entering carbs) you can delay + or - (thus my request is no more justified ;) ) and the target changes.
